source.title: Statement of Faith
source.breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > Statement of Faith (Athanasius)

paragraphs.text: 1. We believe in one Unbegotten God, Father Almighty, maker of all things both visible and invisible, that has His being from Himself. And in one Only-begotten Word, Wisdom, Son, begotten of the Father without beginning and eternally; word not pronounced nor mental, nor an effluence of the Perfect, nor a dividing of the impassible Essence, nor an issue ; but absolutely perfect Son, living and powerful (Hebrews 4:12), the true Image of the Father, equal in honour and glory. For this, he says, 'is the will of the Father, that as they honour the Father, so they may honour the Son also' (John 5:23): very God of very God, as John says in his general Epistles, 'And we are in Him that is true, even in His Son Jesus Christ: this is the true God and everlasting life' (1 John 5:20): Almighty of Almighty. For all things which the Father rules and sways, the Son rules and sways likewise: wholly from the Whole, being like the Father as the Lord says, 'he that has seen Me has seen the Father' (John 14:9). But He was begotten ineffably and incomprehensibly, for 'who shall declare his generation?' (Isaiah 53:8), in other words, no one can. Who, when at the consummation of the ages (Hebrews 9:26), He had descended from the bosom of the Father, took from the undefiled Virgin Mary our humanity (<greek>ἄ</greek><greek>νθρωπον</greek>), Christ Jesus, whom He delivered of His own will to suffer for us, as the Lord saith: 'No man takes My life from Me. I have power to lay it down, and have power to take it again' (John 10:18). In which humanity He was crucified and died for us, and rose from the dead, and was taken up into the heavens, having been created as the beginning of ways for us (Proverbs 8:22), when on earth He showed us light from out of darkness, salvation from error, life from the dead, an entrance to paradise, from which Adam was cast out, and into which he again entered by means of the thief, as the Lord said, 'This day shall you be with Me in paradise' (Luke 23:43), into which Paul also once entered. [He showed us] also a way up to the heavens, whither the humanity of the Lord , in which He will judge the quick and the dead, entered as precursor for us. We believe, likewise, also in the Holy Spirit that searches all things, even the deep things of God (1 Corinthians 2:10), and we anathematise doctrines contrary to this.

2. For neither do we hold a Son-Father, as do the Sabellians, calling Him of one but not of the same essence, and thus destroying the existence of the Son. Neither do we ascribe the passible body which He bore for the salvation of the whole world to the Father. Neither can we imagine three Subsistences separated from each other, as results from their bodily nature in the case of men, lest we hold a plurality of gods like the heathen. But just as a river, produced from a well, is not separate, and yet there are in fact two visible objects and two names. For neither is the Father the Son, nor the Son the Father. For the Father is Father of the Son, and the Son, Son of the Father. For like as the well is not a river, nor the river a well, but both are one and the same water which is conveyed in a channel from the well to the river, so the Father's deity passes into the Son without flow and without division. For the Lord says, 'I came out from the Father and have come' (John 16:28). But He is ever with the Father, for He is in the bosom of the Father, nor was ever the bosom of the Father void of the deity of the Son. For He says, 'I was by Him as one setting in order' (Proverbs 8:30). But we do not regard God the Creator of all, the Son of God, as a creature, or thing made, or as made out of nothing, for He is truly existent from Him who exists, alone existing from Him who alone exists, in as much as the like glory and power was eternally and conjointly begotten of the Father. For 'He that has seen' the Son 'has seen the Father (John 14:9). All things to wit were made through the Son; but He Himself is not a creature, as Paul says of the Lord: 'In Him were all things created, and He is before all' (Colossians 1:16). Now He says not, 'was created' before all things, but 'is' before all things. To be created, namely, is applicable to all things, but 'is before all' applies to the Son only.

3. He is then by nature an Offspring, perfect from the Perfect, begotten before all the hills (Proverbs 8:25), that is before every rational and intelligent essence, as Paul also in another place calls Him 'first-born of all creation' (Colossians 1:15). But by calling Him First-born, He shows that He is not a Creature, but Offspring of the Father. For it would be inconsistent with His deity for Him to be called a creature. For all things were created by the Father through the Son, but the Son alone was eternally begotten from the Father, whence God the Word is 'first-born of all creation,' unchangeable from unchangeable. However, the body which He wore for our sakes is a creature: concerning which Jeremiah says, according to the edition of the seventy translators (Jeremiah 31:22): 'The Lord created for us for a planting a new salvation, in which salvation men shall go about:' but according to Aquila the same text runs: 'The Lord created a new thing in woman.' Now the salvation created for us for a planting, which is new, not old, and for us, not before us, is Jesus, Who in respect of the Saviour was made man, and whose name is translated in one place Salvation, in another Saviour. But salvation proceeds from the Saviour, just as illumination does from the light. The salvation, then, which was from the Saviour, being created new, did, as Jeremiah says, 'create for us a new salvation,' and as Aquila renders: 'The Lord created a new thing in woman,' that is in Mary. For nothing new was created in woman, save the Lord's body, born of the Virgin Mary without intercourse, as also it says in the Proverbs in the person of Jesus: 'The Lord created me, a beginning of His ways for His works' (Proverbs 8:22). Now He does not say, 'created me before His works,' lest any should take the text of the deity of the Word.

4. Each text then which refers to the creature is written with reference to Jesus in a bodily sense. For the Lord's Humanity was created as 'a beginning of ways,' and He manifested it to us for our salvation. For by it we have our access to the Father. For He is the way (John 14:6) which leads us back to the Father. And a way is a corporeal visible thing, such as is the Lord's humanity. Well, then, the Word of God created all things, not being a creature, but an offspring. For He created none of the created things equal or like unto Himself. But it is the part of a Father to beget, while it is a workman's part to create. Accordingly, that body is a thing made and created, which the Lord bore for us, which was begotten for us , as Paul says, 'wisdom from God, and sanctification and righteousness, and redemption;' while yet the Word was before us and before all Creation, and is, the Wisdom of the Father. But the Holy Spirit, being that which proceeds from the Father, is ever in the hands of the Father Who sends and of the Son Who conveys Him, by Whose means He filled all things. The Father, possessing His existence from Himself, begot the Son, as we said, and did not create Him, as a river from a well and as a branch from a root, and as brightness from a light, things which nature knows to be indivisible; through whom to the Father be glory and power and greatness before all ages, and unto all the ages of the ages. Amen.

latex.p0003: 1. 我们信仰一位\OriginalTerm{非受生的}{Unbegotten}天主，全能的圣父，一切有形与无形之物的创造者，祂的存在源于自身。并信仰一位惟一受生者圣言、智慧、圣子，由父在无始之始、永恒中受生；祂不是可发音的话语，也不是内心的话语，不是\OriginalTerm{完美者}{the Perfect}的流溢，不是不被动\OriginalTerm{性体}{Essence}的分割，也不是一种发出；而是全然完美的圣子，活生生而有大能的（\BibleRef{希 4:12}），是父的真像，同享尊荣。为此，祂说：\BibleQuote{这是父的旨意，就如他们尊敬父那样，也要尊敬子。}\BibleRef{若 5:23} 祂是出自真天主的真天主，正如若望在他的公函中所说：\BibleQuote{我们是在那真实者内，就是在祂的圣子耶稣基督内。祂就是真天主和永生。}\BibleRef{若一 5:20} 是全能者生自全能者。因为凡父所统摄引导的一切，子也同样统摄引导：整个出自整个，与父相似，正如主说：\BibleQuote{看见我的，就是看见了父。}\BibleRef{若 14:9} 然而祂以无可言喻、无可彻悟的方式受生，因为\BibleQuote{谁将宣布祂的世代？}\BibleRef{依 53:8} 换言之，无人能宣布。在此世代的终结时（\BibleRef{希 9:26}），祂从父的怀中降下，从无玷童贞玛利亚取得了我们的人性（\OriginalTerm{人性}{ἄνθρωπον}），即基督耶稣；祂甘心情愿将自己的生命交付，为我们受苦，如主所说：\BibleQuote{谁也不能夺去我的生命，是我甘心情愿舍弃的；我有权舍弃，也有权再取回。}\BibleRef{若 10:18} 祂便以此人性为我们被钉十字架而死，又从死者中复活，被提升天，受造为我们道路的开端（\BibleRef{箴 8:22}）。当祂在地上时，祂向我们展示了：从黑暗中发出光明，从错谬中带来救恩，从死亡中获得生命，进入乐园的门径——亚当曾被逐出此乐园，又借着右盗重新进入，正如主说：\BibleQuote{今天你就要与我一同在乐园里。}\BibleRef{路 23:43} 保禄也曾一度进入。 [祂也给我们展示了] 一条通往诸天的道路，主的人性先我们作为前驱进入那里，祂将以这人性的身体审判生者死者。我们同样也信圣神，祂洞察一切，就连天主的深奥事理也洞察（\BibleRef{格前 2:10}），我们将与此相反的道理一律予以绝罚。
latex.p0004: 2. 因为我们不持守\Quote{子父}论，如同撒伯里乌派（\OriginalTerm{撒伯里乌派}{Sabellians}）那样，称祂为一位，而非同一性体，从而摧毁了圣子的存在。我们也不把祂为普世的救恩所负的可受苦的身体归于圣父。我们也不能想象三个位格彼此分离，如同人因形体本性而彼此分离一样，免得我们像异教徒那样信奉多神。然而就像河出自泉源，并非分离，但事实上是两个可见之物，有两个名字。因为圣父不是圣子，圣子也不是圣父。因为圣父是圣子的父，圣子是圣父的子。因为如同泉源不是河，河也不是泉源，但二者是同一条水，从泉源借水道流到河里，同样，圣父的天主性通传于圣子，无流动也无分割。因主说：\BibleQuote{我出自父而来到世上。}\BibleRef{若 16:28} 但祂时时与父同在，因为祂在父的怀中，父的怀中从未缺少圣子的天主性。因为祂说：\BibleQuote{我在祂身旁，犹如技师。}\BibleRef{箴 8:30} 但我们不把创造万有的天主、天主子，视为受造物、被造之物，或是从虚无造成的，因为祂真实出于自有着，由独自存在者唯一所生，因为同等的荣耀与权能永远地、协同地由圣父受生。因为\BibleQuote{看见圣子的，就是看见了父。}\BibleRef{若 14:9} 万物确实借圣子造成；但祂自身并非受造物，正如保禄论及主说：\BibleQuote{在祂内，万有都受造了，祂在万有之先。}\BibleRef{哥 1:16} 此处没有说：\Quote{在万有之先受造}，而是\Quote{在万有之先}存在。因为，受造适用于万有，但\Quote{在万有之先}却只适用于圣子。
latex.p0005: 3. 因此，祂按本性是子嗣（\OriginalTerm{子嗣}{Offspring}），由完美者所生之完美者，在所有山陵之前受生（\BibleRef{箴 8:25}），即在一切理性与理智的实体之前。正如保禄在另一处称祂为\BibleQuote{一切受造物的首生者}\BibleRef{哥 1:15}。但称祂为首生者，表明祂并非受造物，而是圣父的子嗣。因为被称为受造物与祂的天主性不相称。因为万有都是圣父借圣子造成，唯独圣子永远由圣父受生，因此，天主的圣言是\Quote{一切受造物的首生者}，从不变者而不变者。然而，祂为我们所取的身体是受造物：关于此，耶肋米亚按七十贤士译本说：\BibleQuote{上主为栽植我们，创造了新的救恩，使人在这救恩中行走。}\BibleRef{耶 31:22} 但按阿桂拉译本，同一经文是：\BibleQuote{上主在女人内造了一件新事。}\BibleRef{耶 31:22} 这为栽植我们而造的救恩，是新的而非旧的，是为我们而非在我们之先的，就是耶稣，祂身为救主而成为人，其名一处译为\Quote{救恩}，一处译为\Quote{救主}。但救恩由救主而来，如同光明由光而来。因此，从救主来的救恩，既被造成新的，就如耶肋米亚所说：\BibleQuote{上主为我们造了新的救恩}，又如阿桂拉所译：\BibleQuote{上主在女人内造了一件新事，}即在玛利亚内。因为在女人内，除了主由童贞玛利亚非由男女交合所生的身体外，没有任何新事被造。如在\WorkTitle{箴言}中也以耶稣的口吻说：\BibleQuote{上主创造了我，作为祂行径的开端，为祂工程之始基。}\BibleRef{箴 8:22} 此处没有说\Quote{在祂工程之先创造了我}，免得任何人将这文本理解为指圣言的天主性。
latex.p0006: 4. 因此，每一段提及受造物的经文，都是在身体的意义上提及\Person{耶稣}的。因为主的人性被造为\Quote{道路的开端}，并为了我们的救恩将它显示给我们。因为我们藉着它，得以进到圣父面前。因为祂就是那条道路\BibleRef{若 14:6}，引领我们归向圣父。而道路是属形可见的事物，正如主的人性那样。那么，\OriginalTerm{圣言}{the Word of God}创造了万有，祂并非受造物，而是所生的子。因为祂受造的万物中没有一个与祂同等或相似的。生是圣父的本分，而造是工匠的本分。因此，那身体是受造之物，是主为我们所担负的，是为我们所生的，一如\Person{保禄}所说：\BibleQuote{从天主而来的智慧、正义、圣化和救赎}\BibleRef{格前 1:30}。然而圣言在我们之前，在一切受造之前，祂是圣父的智慧。而圣神，既由圣父所发出，则常在那派遣祂的圣父和那传递祂的圣子手中，藉着圣子，祂充满万有。圣父拥有从自身而来的存在，如我们所说，生了圣子，而非造了祂，如同泉源流出河流，如同根生出枝，如同光发出光辉，这些都是本性上不可分离的事物；愿光荣、能力与尊威，藉着祂，归于圣父，于万世之前，及至无穷之世。阿们。
